description: skillx.release/v1 signed manifest vectors. The test key is derived from a public seed text and MUST NOT be trusted outside tests.
canonicalization: signature = padded base64 Ed25519 over UTF-8 canonical JSON (RFC 8785 subset: members sorted by UTF-16 code units, no whitespace, non-negative safe integers only, only quote/backslash/C0 controls escaped, everything else raw UTF-8) of the manifest without its signature member; see packages/contracts/src/canonical-json.ts
verifierRules: parse document and re-encode it canonically; any byte difference (whitespace, member order, duplicate member, escapes, number form, BOM, trailing bytes, invalid UTF-8) is release.non_canonical

validate the structure; an unknown member, including one differing from a known member only by case, is unknown_field; a signature not matching ^[A-Za-z0-9+/]{85}[AQgw]==$ (non-zero unused base64 bits included) is pattern
require releaseDigest == 'sha256:' + hex SHA-256 of treeSerialization (agentkit.skill-tree/v1 of files), else release.tree_digest_mismatch
verify the signature with the trusted key for keyId over the canonical JSON without signature: signature.unknown_key, signature.invalid_key or signature.mismatch

testKey.seedText: skillx.release/v1 test vector key; public, never trusted

valid.name: unverified minimal prerelease with unknown provenance
paths ordered by UTF-8 bytes, not UTF-16 code units

rejected.name: signed by another key under the trusted key ID
signature with non-zero unused base64 bits (same bytes for a lenient decoder)
releaseDigest is not the tree digest of files, correctly signed
member differing from a known one only by case

invalidManifest.name: rejects a version with build metadata
rejects a version with a leading zero
rejects a numeric prerelease identifier with a leading zero
rejects a version longer than 128 characters
rejects a release state member, which belongs to the status document
rejects an identity with a reserved device-name slug
rejects a publisher handle that differs from the identity
rejects a declared script missing from files
rejects a timestamp with fractional seconds
rejects a key ID outside the registry pattern
